title: AI结构性变革全景：自修改网络、测试时缩放代理与资本向大模型聚焦
core_insight: 自修改神经网络与自进化代理的出现标志着模型学习范式的突破，同时资本正高度聚焦大模型训练平台，推动AI能力与商业落地同步加速。

dimension_texts.technology: 音频大语言模型实现情感识别，Chain‑of‑Thought 首词可控性提升；AutoHebb展示零样本推理与持续学习能力，表明模型在未知情境下的适应性提升。 提出 Agentic World Modeling 用于测试时缩放以及自进化代理基准；自修改神经网络（AutoHebb）实现推理时自我重构权重，推动新一代代理训练与混合生成策略。 Incongruence-Aware Evaluation of Multimodal Speech Emotion Recognition in Audio Large Language Models Agentic World Modeling for Agent Test-time Scaling without Environment Replica The First Few Tokens Matter: Understanding Chain-of-Thought Controllability AutoHebb: Self-Modifying Neural Networks that Zero-Shot Infer and Continually Learn The Generative Gap Between Speculative Drafter and Continuous Diffusion Language Model
dimension_texts.infrastructure: 今日未见推理成本下降或新高效方案的报道。 暂无芯片发布、算力或云定价变动信息。
dimension_texts.application: AI在公共部门规划、代码审查、日常任务助理（LifeVal）以及配电网状态估计、工业物联网边缘异常检测和物理仿真等多场景落地。 AI原生代码审查插件取代手工审查，提升缺陷捕获率；传统配电网状态估计和边缘异常检测方法被基于贝叶斯学习和任务感知的AI模型替代，降低人工特征工程需求。 LifeVal Qodo builds context into AI code review with Codex Speeding up planning decisions with AI Bayesian Distribution System State Estimation with Flow Matching Don't Just Impute, Detect: Task-Aware Diffusion Pipelines for Edge Anomaly Detection Frozen in Time: How a Physics Foundation Model Forgets Under Sim-to-Real Adaptation
